Entries: SQS batch input: the messages one batch call sends
MessageBody: AWS SDK v3: SendMessageCommand input field
QueueUrl: AWS SDK v3: SendMessageCommand input field
Records: AWS Lambda: SQSEvent field holding the delivered messages
SQSRecord: AWS Lambda: the type of one delivered SQS message
binds: suss: resolution fact, a name and the value it is bound to, which the receive reads
body: AWS Lambda: SQSRecord field holding the message payload
elementOf: suss: resolution fact, a loop or callback variable and the collection it is given one element of, which the receive reads
func: suss: resolution fact, a function written out, which the receive reads to tell a name from a value
objectValue: suss: resolution fact, an object written out, which the receive reads to tell a name from a value
readsEntry: suss: resolution fact, a read of an entry under a key written out, which the receive reads
readsProperty: suss: resolution fact, a read of a property, which the receive reads
writtenValue: suss: resolution fact, a value written out, which the receive reads to tell a name from a value
